top_missing.text: Triggers all Socketed Spells and loses all Energy on reaching maximum Energy (Not supported in PoB yet)
Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.
Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
Supported Skills deal 30% less Damage with Hits
Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Rapidly fire bolts that Break enemy Armour. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay. making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.
Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.
Totem gains +75% to all Elemental Resistances

Fire a Projectile at every nearby enemy that is afflicted by a Chaos damage over time Debuff. Fires multiple Projectiles at enemies afflicted by multiple Debuffs, but Projectile count cannot be otherwise modified.
Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.
Supported Skills have 25% less Projectile Speed
Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.
Enemies killed by Hits from Supported Skills grant 100% more Mana Flask Charges (Not supported in PoB yet)
Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. These fragments can Merge.
Rapidly fire charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. Can fire a limited number of bursts before needing to reload. These fragments can Merge.

Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
Limit 1 Marked target (Not supported in PoB yet)
Hits against Marked enemy cause 35% more Freeze buildup
Buff grants 30% of damage Gained as Cold damage
Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.
Consumes up to 1 Corpse (Not supported in PoB yet)
Ignites as though dealing 146 to 218 Fire damage
Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
Supported Skills have 15% increased Attack Speed
Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.
Supported Skills have 35% increased Attack Speed
Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.
